up: List all approved drugs whose mechanism of action is a positive allosteric modulator. For each drug, include the target identifier, the preferred name of the target, the ChEMBL ID of the target, the drug's ChEMBL ID, the drug's preferred name, and the canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS molecule_pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM drug_mechanism dm
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  dm.action_type = 'POSITIVE ALLOSTERIC MODULATOR'
  AND md.max_phase = 4;
